mapper.sql: a.achievement_id AS "achievementId", a.management_no AS "managementNo", a.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", u.login_id AS "teacherName", u.employee_no AS "employeeNo", a.organization_code AS "organizationCode", a.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", a.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date AS "achievementDate", a.achievement_name AS "achievementName", a.achievement_detail AS "achievementDetail", a.achievement_status AS "achievementStatus", a.achievement_status AS "certificationStatus", a.attachment_ref AS "attachmentRef", a.created_at AS "createdAt", a.created_by AS "createdBy", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt", a.updated_by AS "updatedBy"
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
SELECT FROM education_achievements a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-032' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, achievement_name = #{achievementName}, achievement_detail = #{achievementDetail}, attachment_ref = #{attachmentRef}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actorId}, request_id = #{requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'FR-032' AND teacher_user_id = #{actorId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, next_status, action_type, opinion, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('FR-032', #{id}, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', '취업률 실적 최초 입력', #{userId}, #{requestId})
mapper.select: SELECT j.batch_job_id AS "jobId", j.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", j.action_type AS "actionType", j.status, j.total_count AS "totalCount", j.processed_count AS "processedCount", j.unprocessed_count AS "unprocessedCount", j.seed_yn AS "seedYn", j.requested_at AS "requestedAt" FROM employment_rate_batch_jobs j WHERE j.batch_job_id = #{id} AND (j.requester_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_organization_mappings pm WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.organization_code = j.organization_code AND pm.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND pm.data_scope IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') ))

SELECT i.target_user_id AS "targetUserId", i.achievement_id AS "achievementId", i.processed_yn AS "processedYn", i.unprocessed_reason AS "unprocessedReason" FROM employment_rate_batch_job_items i WHERE i.batch_job_id = #{id} ORDER BY i.batch_job_item_id
